messages:
nora: Quick feedback on the tiny-tile chart in staging. Axis unit labels overlap legend chips at 220px and screen readers read every tick. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/7007

ev an: For tiny tiles propose moving the unit into a compact unit chip next to the axis (e.g., "ms") and using SI suffixes for numbers >999. Keeps labels short and stops collisions.

sami: Legend alternative: show colored chips (2-4 chars) instead of full text, with a keyboard-focusable flyout that exposes full series names and toggles (smoothed, hide). Flyout should be aria-trap when open.

jo: Outlier handling idea: cap chart at p95 and render an "overflow mini-strip" above the chart with tiny stacked markers representing outliers. Add an interactive pill that reads "3 outliers" and opens a modal with details.

a11y-checker: accessibility-note: screen readers need a concise summary instead of every tick. Provide `aria-label` like "Latency chart: median 120ms; p95 430ms. Details available in legend flyout." Also include an offscreen table with full datapoints for SR users.

sami: Smoothing: keep raw line default. Offer a smoothed overlay toggle in the flyout and show a subtle microbadge on a chip when enabled (using "∿ Smoothed"). Do not change alerting thresholds based on smoothing.

ev an: For overlapping outliers, prefer a stacked mini-dot showing count instead of jitter. Tooltip should list values and be keyboard navigable.

jo: Copy: unit chip tooltip: "milliseconds (ms)"; overflow pill aria-label: "3 outliers above 2.4 seconds, view details". Keep visible text compact.

a11y-checker: Live updates: use `aria-live="polite"` on the overflow pill and debounce updates to max once every 4s to avoid spamming.

product-lu: Noted for release notes. Please gate behind feature flag and keep existing dashboards unchanged by default.

nora: Next steps: evan to mock unit chip + condensed chips, sami to prototype flyout + smoothed overlay, jo to prototype overflow mini-strip and modal, a11y-checker to run VoiceOver/NVDA checks. We'll reconvene after the a11y pass.
